papers.title: Latent Compaction with Test-Time Training
papers.summary: Learns compact, document-specific KV caches through test-time training so that retrieval accuracy is preserved under heavy cache compression. This targets the memory cost of long-context LLM inference.

papers.title: Mechanics of Long-Context Hybrid Models Part 1.1: From Hybrid Attention to Hybrid Position
papers.summary: Explains why hybrid attention LLMs differ in context extension versus length extrapolation, shifting the focus from hybrid attention to hybrid position handling. Proposes Sliding-Window Linear Attention based on this analysis, backed by extensive experiments.
